text: Denndaangal e ñaameteeji laaɓuɗi ɗin laatino daginanaaɗi ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, huunde harmaano ɓe e majji,si wanaa ko Yaaquuba harminannoo hoore-mun ado Jippineede Tawreeta, wanaa no Alyahuuda en aaƴorta wonnde kon ko harminanoo no wonno ka Tawreetaare. Maakan ɓee anAnnabiijo: "Addee Tawreetaare nden janngon nde si on laatike goonguɓe e kon ko nodditiɗon", ɓe mugaa ɓe addaani nde. Ɗum ko misal tinndinayngal e fefindaare Alyahuuda en e hoore Tawreetaare nden, wayla ko woni ko e nder hende.
